mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, status FROM interest_tag WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND id = #{id} AND code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{code}, '%') AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') ORDER BY id
SELECT id, code, name, status FROM interest_tag WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, code, name, status FROM interest_tag WHERE name = #{name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interest_tag (code, name, status) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, 'ACTIVE') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = interest_tag.name
